title: Render Props vs Hooks
description: Compare render props with custom hooks and understand when to use each.

data.text: With the introduction of hooks, many render prop patterns can be replaced with custom hooks. Let's compare both approaches.

data.title: Comparison

items: When the consumer needs to control the rendering
When you want to share logic without creating a new component
When the component tree structure matters
When you want cleaner, flatter component trees
When logic doesn't affect the rendered output structure
When you need to compose multiple pieces of logic

data.title: Modern Preference
data.text: Custom hooks are generally preferred in modern React for their cleaner syntax and better composability. Render props are still useful when rendering flexibility is needed.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Hooks often replace render props for cleaner code
Render props offer more rendering flexibility
Choose based on whether structure or logic is the priority
Both patterns solve the same problem differently
data.takeaway: Understand both patterns to choose the right tool for each situation.
